title: NUSTAR Run 2026 Review: Cebu's Luxury Resort Road Race
seo_title: NUSTAR Run 2026 Review | Cebu Philippines Resort Race
meta_description: NUSTAR Run 2026: August 23 at NUSTAR Resort, Cebu City. A luxury resort-anchored road race in the Queen City of the South.
dek: Set for 23 August 2026 at NUSTAR Resort in Cebu City, this resort-organised race brings road racing to Cebu's premier luxury integrated resort complex.
verdict: The NUSTAR Run is a resort-organised road race at NUSTAR Resort — Cebu's premier luxury integrated resort complex with a casino, hotels, and waterfront dining. A resort-anchored race means quality amenities, convenient logistics (stay where you race), and a polished finish-line experience. August in Cebu is the transition into the northeast monsoon — warm and humid. For runners wanting a Cebu race with resort-level production values and a luxury backdrop, this is a distinctive pick.
